summary: Ventas, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to amend its ATM sales agreement, increasing the aggregate gross sales price available for common stock issuance to $3 billion. The filing updates an at-the-market offering program, not tied to any specific acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. Shares may be sold through ordinary brokers' transactions on the NYSE at prevailing market prices. The company also describes forward sale agreements with multiple financial institutions for hedging purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown and capital-raising mechanism, not a special-situation event.
